subject.title: feat(gateway): land remaining durable-approvals stack and repair main gates

question: Should shipped plugins that set `timeoutBehavior: "allow"` continue to allow on timeout during a deprecation release, or should this stack intentionally make all unresolved approvals fail closed immediately?
rationale: The intended security invariant conflicts with a still-public and documented plugin behavior, so implementation review cannot safely choose the compatibility policy.

options.title: Preserve one-release compatibility
options.body: Honor the field for one deprecation train while warning and documenting migration, then remove it in a later approved break.

options.title: Approve immediate fail-closed
options.body: Ignore the field now and explicitly own the plugin upgrade impact with release guidance and upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve one-release compatibility
recommendation.body: Honor the field for one deprecation train while warning and documenting migration, then remove it in a later approved break.

likelyOwner.reason: The current approval stack and fail-closed policy were authored and coordinated by this contributor, making them the best available owner for the policy choice.
